property_summary: For any target that accepts a low-level call (i.e., its fallback/receive does not revert), the reference contract's sendMoney succeeds (does not revert) when invoked with sufficient value, whereas the mutant inverts the check and will revert for such targets; thus the reference never reverts for accepting callees while the mutant does for some inputs.
change_summary: Invert the call result requirement to require call failed (require __sent_result100 == false), causing sendMoney to revert on success and proceed only when the call returns false, changing observable behavior.
